instruction:
Create a 12-column circular colonnade from the opened Column mesh. Use ArrayMesh to place 12 copies at 30-degree intervals around the world Y axis, with each centroid at radius 2.0 BU and y=1. Use Make Mesh to commit the array to geometry, then Split to Parts or Split to Similar Parts so all twelve columns become separate parts. Rename them Col_01 through Col_12 and export `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj`.

The OBJ must contain exactly twelve object/group blocks with those names. Each must have 8 vertices, 6 quad faces, Y extent [0,2] within 0.01 BU, radius 2.0 within 0.02 BU, and consecutive centroid angles separated by 30 degrees within 0.5 degree.

command:
import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
